provenance.instrument: Joint Municipal Zoning Ordinance of Newtown, Upper Makefield and Wrightstown Townships (readopted effective 6/23/2007 by JMZO Ord. 2007, as amended), as published on eCode360 (Newtown Area Zoning Jointure)
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 shows no code date for the Jointure code. New Laws on 2026-11-14: Ord. No. 2026-01 (Utility Placement, B-17 Elderly House Usage, adopted 2026-05-19, Article VIII), Ord. No. 2026-03 (Data Center G-17, 2026-08-19, Article VIII), Ord. No. 2022-03 (signs, 2026-05-19) and Ord. No. 2022-01 (small wireless facilities, 2026-05-19). Not read (PDF only).
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 shows no currency date for the Newtown Area Zoning Jointure code. The latest codified amendment seen is JMZO Ord. No. 2022-02 (adopted 7/21/2025).
provenance.code_caution: Four New Laws are not yet in the code text: Ord. No. 2026-01 (B-17 Elderly House Usage, Article VIII, adopted 2026-05-19), Ord. No. 2026-03 (Article VIII, 2026-08-19), Ord. No. 2022-03 and Ord. No. 2022-01 (2026-05-19). They were not read and may change Article VIII. The ordinance is shared with Upper Makefield and Wrightstown, so check which districts are mapped in Newtown Township.
checks: A residential accessory structure (use H-3) may include 'No greater than one residential accessory apartment for domestic servants, caretakers employed on the premises, occasional gratuitous guests, or for permanent residence of family members related by blood, marriage, or adoption' (Article VIII, 803 H-3.4)
Use H-3 is a use by right in JM, CM, CR-1, CR-2, R-1, R-2, VR-1 and VR-4 (404 to 409, each 'and no other'). The office, commercial, industrial and other district use lists were not read
At least two off-street parking spaces for each dwelling unit, none in the front yard, side and rear parking screened from the street and neighbors (H-3.4a)
A Bucks County Department of Health permit certifying the sewage facilities for two family uses, and evidence the water supply serves the apartment without harming neighbors' supply (H-3.4b, d)
New construction meets the yard and setback rules for a single-family dwelling in the district. The 12 ft (or 6 ft) accessory building setback of 1000.E.4 does not apply (H-3.4c)

An attached apartment keeps the look of a single-family house. One in an accessory building keeps the look of a garage, barn or similar building. When the family member use ends, the space reverts to a permitted use (H-3.4e, f)

Residential conversion (use B-16): an existing dwelling into more than one dwelling, or an accessory building into one dwelling, if the building existed at least 15 years before the Joint Municipal Zoning Ordinance was adopted. Conditional use in CM and CR-1 (non-cluster), R-1 and QA, special exception in VR-1. Lot area per dwelling unit at least the single-family minimum, 2 parking spaces per unit, added units at least 600 sq ft (efficiency), 700 (one bedroom) or 950 (two bedrooms) (803 B-16)
Conflicting text, ask: B-16.8 names CM, but the CM use lists (401) do not list B-16. TC-2 and QA-A list B-16 (604, 700-A.5), B-16.8 does not name them
CR-2: the performance table gives a 30,000 sq ft single-family lot, the dimensional table 20,000 sq ft (403B, 403C). Conflicting text, ask
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Newtown Township (Bucks County) Zoning Officer. Joint Zoning Hearing Boards under Article XV. Read on eCode360 (NE3758, Newtown Area Zoning Jointure) in a browser, one page at a time, on 2026-11-14. eCode360 NE1450 'Township of Newtown' is Newtown Township in Delaware County and was not used. The first code search (all content) for 'accessory dwelling', 'accessory apartment', 'in-law', ECHO, granny, 'family dwelling', relative, caretaker, 'housekeeping unit', 'guest house', 'accessory unit', 'living quarters' and conversion showed the family definition and Residential Conversion (B-16) listings. The residential accessory apartment (H-3.4) was found by reading use H-3 and confirmed by a search for 'accessory apartment', 'accessory building' and 'accessory structure'. Article IV read in full for JM, CM, CR-1, CR-2, R-1, R-2 and VR-1. VR-4 use list read, its tables not read. Articles V to VII-A (office, commercial, industrial, other districts) not read except search excerpts (B-16 in TC-2, QA and QA-A).

term.note: Part of use H-3, Residential Accessory Structure. No separate definition was read.

status.note: Allowed by right with use H-3, but only 'for domestic servants, caretakers employed on the premises, occasional gratuitous guests, or for permanent residence of family members related by blood, marriage, or adoption'.

scope_by_use.note: Use H-3 is a use by right in every residential district. Other district lists were not read.

status_outside.note: No use H-3 listing was read outside the residential districts.

path.note: Use H-3 is a use by right. A zoning permit, a Bucks County Department of Health sewage permit and a building permit apply.

fallback_path.note: Relief from a district rule is a variance from the local Zoning Hearing Board.

value.name: Residential conversion (use B-16)
value.conditions: Conversion of an existing dwelling into more than one dwelling, or of an accessory building into one dwelling. District yards met. Lot area per dwelling unit at least the district minimum for a single-family detached dwelling. Outside look keeps the existing bulk. Fire escapes and outside stairs at the rear or side. Two parking spaces per unit, none in the front yard. Each added unit at least 600 sq ft (efficiency), 700 (one bedroom) or 950 (two bedrooms). Pennsylvania Labor and Industry and Bucks County Department of Health rules.

requires.condition: The dwelling or accessory building existed at least 15 years before the Joint Municipal Zoning Ordinance was adopted

value.note: Conditional use from the Board of Supervisors. CM and CR-1 for non-cluster lots only. CM is named in B-16.8 but its use lists (401) do not list B-16, so ask. Lot figures are two units at the single-family minimum (R-1 with public water and sewer, 60,000 sq ft per unit without).

value.name: Residential conversion (use B-16) by special exception in VR-1
value.conditions: As above. 'Minimum lot area required per dwelling unit' 30,000 sq ft in VR-1.

requires.condition: The dwelling or accessory building existed at least 15 years before the Joint Municipal Zoning Ordinance was adopted

zoning_districts.note: Use H-3 by right in each residential district.

building_types.note: Single-family detached dwellings (use B-1) are the house type in these districts. Twins and townhouses occur only in performance subdivisions.

value.condition: Occupied only by domestic servants, caretakers employed on the premises, occasional gratuitous guests, or as the permanent residence of family members related by blood, marriage or adoption.
A Bucks County Department of Health permit certifying that the sewage facilities are adequate for two family uses.
Satisfactory evidence that the water supply serves all uses, the apartment included, without appreciably affecting neighbors' water supply.
Attached to the house: keeps the look of a single-family residence. In an accessory building: keeps the look of a garage, barn or other accessory structure.
'Upon termination of the family member use of the accessory structure, its use shall revert only to a permitted use in the zoning district.'

types_allowed.note: Attached to the house or within an accessory building. New construction is allowed if it meets the single-family yards. A unit inside the house is read as attached.

max_height_ft.note: The district tables give a 35 ft maximum building height for every use. No separate accessory building height was found.

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: 'Any new construction conforms to the yard and building setback requirements for single family dwellings in the zoning district in which the use is located. (Requirements of § 1000.E.4 do not apply to this use.)'

internal_uses_district_height.note: 35 ft in the residential districts read (three stories at most in JM, CR-1, CR-2).

family_only.note: Family members, domestic servants, caretakers employed on the premises or occasional guests only.

occupancy.value: Domestic servants, caretakers employed on the premises, occasional gratuitous guests, or family members related by blood, marriage or adoption as permanent residents.

max_adus.note: 'No greater than one residential accessory apartment.'

spaces_required.note: 'Not less than two off-street parking spaces shall be provided for each dwelling unit.' None in the front yard.

total_on_site.note: Two for each dwelling unit, the house and the apartment.

new_connection_required.note: A County Health Department sewage permit for two family uses, no connection rule.

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached: 5 acres, width 300 ft, 60 ft frontage. Impervious 0.05.
Single-family detached: 1 acre, width 200 ft, 100 ft between buildings. 20,000 sq ft building envelope (401D).
Single-family detached: 1 acre, width 150 ft. Impervious 0.18.
Conflicting text, ask. The performance table (403B) gives 30,000 sq ft, the dimensional table (403C) 20,000 sq ft. Width 110 ft, 50 ft between buildings. Impervious 0.18.
With public water and sewer. Width 125 ft at the setback line, 100 ft at the street. Impervious 0.12.

value.when: With on-lot water and sewage disposal

utility_rows.note: The table gives one row for on-lot water and sewage and one for public water and sewer. A lot with only one of them is not settled.

min_lot_sqft.note: With public water and sewer. Width 100 ft at the setback line, 75 ft at the street. Impervious 0.13.

value.when: With on-lot water and sewage disposal

utility_rows.note: The table gives one row for on-lot water and sewage and one for public water and sewer. A lot with only one of them is not settled.

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family detached. Width 100 ft. Impervious 0.18 (0.50 in Wrightstown).
